title: apparent frog collection
referencePrompt: Use the attached apparent frog image as the character reference. Preserve its chunky pixel-art silhouette, olive body, cream belly, oversized eyes, dark outline and warm cheek accents. Make a new pose: [describe the action]. Keep the expression friendly, peculiar and playful. Retain the pixel texture; do not turn it into a smooth vector, glossy 3D mascot or photorealistic frog. Keep text and logos out of the image. State the intended background explicitly.
